basics.name: Kevin Kim
basics.label: Bioinformatician & Cryo-EM Data Analyst
basics.summary: Bioinformatics graduate student with experience in cryo-EM reconstruction, RNA-seq analysis, and AI/ML tooling for molecular biology.

work.name: Massachusetts General Hospital, Harvard Medical School — Molecular Biology
work.summary: Segmented and reconstructed mitochondrial datasets to study morphology changes during muscle cell differentiation.
highlights: Segmented 3D FIB-SEB images in Imaris/MATLAB to map mitochondrial and lipid droplet spatial distributions.
Reconstructed 250 Cryo-ET datasets with Amira 3D to quantify morphological differences.
Quantified membrane morphology features in Unix/Linux environments; demonstrated oxygen-dependent inner/outer membrane distance changes.

work.name: Massachusetts General Hospital, Harvard Medical School — Molecular Pathology
work.summary: Built AI/ML pipelines and RNA-seq analyses for cancer biomarker discovery.
highlights: Deployed AI/ML pipelines to predict fusion protein folding for lung cancer studies.
Authored Bash utilities and documentation to streamline bioinformatics Python workflows for lab members.
Analyzed 50 RNA-seq glioblastoma datasets; performed statistical testing on gene effect scores and visualized results in R.

work.name: Occidental College, Biology Department
work.summary: Investigated inflammatory mechanisms in macrophage cultures infected with Group A Streptococcus.
highlights: Identified secreted cytotoxic proteins driving inflammatory responses.
Harvested proteins for ELISA-based detection and performed Western Blot for protein identification.
Presented semesterly reports covering experimental design, analyses, and findings.

work.name: Cap Consulting Institute
work.summary: Tutored and mentored students in STEM subjects and college applications.
highlights: Tutored 20 students in SAT Math, AP Biology, AP Chemistry, and SAT writing, tracking progress in Excel and driving near-perfect scores.
Proctored mock SAT exams for 100+ students to tailor lesson plans.
Led weekly personal statement workshops for 50+ students, achieving 100% college admission for participants.
